title: Delta Thanksgiving 2026: Closures, Trash and Transit

evidence.demandEvidence: Thanksgiving Monday is October 12, 2026. Delta published its facility schedule on October 9, while the City collection page and TransLink holiday notice document two additional changes residents must plan around.
evidence.readerImpact: Delta residents can see which civic facilities are open or closed, move curbside collection one day later for the rest of the week, and plan for Sunday/holiday transit service and one-zone holiday fares.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: The City of Delta facility notice is dated October 9, 2026, three days before Thanksgiving. TransLink's active service-change page names Monday, October 12, and Delta's current 2026 collection page states the statutory-holiday delay rule.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: The City notice covers buildings but not the collection shift or regional transit schedule. A single Delta-first checklist connects all three official changes without making readers search separate agencies.

sourceCaptures.title: 2026 Thanksgiving Day Hours of Operation
excerpts: Monday, October 12 is the Thanksgiving Day holiday.
Delta City Hall and the Delta Community Animal Shelter are closed.
Delta Parks, Recreation & Culture facilities are open for regular hours of operation.
Douglas J. Husband Discovery Centre is open noon to 5 p.m.
North Delta Recreation Centre is open for regular hours, but its Municipal Services Office is closed.
Tsawwassen Arts Centre, North Delta Centre for the Arts, McKee Seniors Recreation Centre and Kennedy Seniors Recreation Centre are closed.

sourceCaptures.title: Collection Schedule
excerpts: Garbage, recycling, and Green Can materials are collected every week and must be curbside by 7 a.m. on the designated collection day.
Following a statutory holiday, collection is delayed by one day for the remainder of that week only.
When Monday is a statutory holiday, Monday collection moves to Tuesday, Wednesday collection moves to Thursday, and Thursday collection moves to Friday.
Regular collection days resume the following week.

sourceCaptures.title: Service Changes
excerpts: On Thanksgiving Day, Monday, October 12, bus, SkyTrain and SeaBus operate on a Sunday/holiday schedule.
West Coast Express does not operate.
The TransLink Customer Service Centre, Access Transit Customer Care Office and Lost Property Office are closed.
Holiday fares are in effect, so one-zone fare is enough for travel across all zones.
Regular weekday service and fares return Tuesday, October 13.
